# UZEmarkets — Word Graph

> The Word Graph is a counted census of a period's market-record vocabulary — concepts, a constraint-only risk lens, and a co-occurrence pathway graph — published by L2Launch as a UZEmarkets market analysis. Counted first, interpreted second. Editions read cumulative corpora (week-to-date, month-to-date).

## Editions
- [October 2026 Edition (human page)](https://uze-web-uze2.vercel.app/word-graph/2026-10-31.html): dated 2026-10-31, production v1. October belonged to the Anthropic IPO complex and the compute build-out; custody was the binding constraint.
- [October 2026 Edition (agent JSON)](https://uze-web-uze2.vercel.app/word-graph/2026-10-31.json): the same census as structured data — concept counts, risk lens, pathway graph, corpus metadata.
- [October 2026 Edition (audio program)](https://uze-web-uze2.vercel.app/word-graph/2026-10-31.mp3): the edition read aloud with music bookends.
- [Editions index (JSON manifest)](https://uze-web-uze2.vercel.app/word-graph/index.json)

## About
UZEmarkets is an information market for utility and usefulness, under construction. When the platform launches, the same data discipline extends to UZE Information Markets on blockchain, around its core competencies: ticketing, stay, and events and venues. Ask us how you UZE Information Markets on blockchain, for next year — testnet space is limited. L2Launch — the launchpad accelerator — produces the Word Graph weekly; the trend read opens the Saturday podcast, and each month closes with a Month in Review. Agents may fetch the JSON editions freely; cite "UZEmarkets Word Graph" with the edition and date.

Offer note: the weekly edition and the Month in Review at this address are offered at no cost to UZEmarkets affiliates and to Learn2Launch project partner owners — a standing service, at our own URL, unmasked. Layered data products (multi-edition trend layers) are a UZE CI service, not a UZEmarkets-site offer.
